title: Mounted Walk crash remains stationary and returns control

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 155 (cyndaquil), acquired through mount; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Mount the current Cyndaquil follower; Hold Up into the fixed blocked wall until the crash presentation completes; Request one recovery Walk after the crash returns control

Both mounted objects retain the same logical location during Crash and remain attached to the live actor.

limits: The original six-row contract remains required. Prepared setup and a meter pass alone do not prove this scenario.

Native sound-start success does not prove audible speaker output. A separate current same-reader control must be accepted.
